chunks: All heads will be bowed before the Living, the Eternal; and whosoever bears a load of iniquity will be full of despair.

key_terms.الْحَيِّ: The Ever-Living, one who never dies
key_terms.الْقَيُّومِ: The Self-Subsisting, the Sustainer of all

ai.seo_question: What does it mean for the faces to bow before the Living, the Eternal?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate subjugation of all beings to Allah’s absolute sovereignty, contrasting the eternal stability of the 'Ever-Living' with the transient nature of creation. It serves as a profound eschatological warning, particularly in the context of the Day of Judgment, where the weight of one's deeds—whether righteous or oppressive—determines eternal success or failure.
